summary: Completed comprehensive testing of XLS/XLSX support and auto-chart generation. All 12 backend tests passed (100%). All UI features verified working across Brand, Publisher, and Admin dashboards. Both CSV and XLSX reports display with auto-generated charts from numeric columns.

issues: Console warnings about chart width/height being -1 during initial render - cosmetic issue, charts render correctly after layout settles

extract_metrics_from_rows() extracts summary metrics from numeric columns
ReportChart component auto-detects numeric columns and generates BarChart
Charts use recharts BarChart with up to 4 numeric columns displayed
Both Brand and Admin upload endpoints support XLS/XLSX files

Admin can upload reports for any brand via /api/admin/brand-reports/{brand_id}/upload-csv endpoint.
